name: moundbook-security-tests
description: Local-emulator security tests for the Mound Book / Brier Stats Firestore rules and the Brier Stats client. Never talks to the real Firebase project.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-moundbook "node --test rules.test.mjs smoke-game-night.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:client && npm run check
